product_understanding.intent: Confirm the product intent before the factory starts Product SOT, architecture or execution.
target_users: target product users to be confirmed by the operator
scope_in: bounded first product outcome to be confirmed before Product SOT
scope_out_non_goals: implementation, deploy, credentials, funds, signing and release are not approved by this packet
ux_expectations: operator-readable product experience expectations must be captured before Product SOT
architecture_preview: architecture constraints and integration boundaries must be previewed before material execution
access_and_capabilities: missing access or capability requirements must be listed early instead of discovered during execution
risk_boundaries: authority, access, budget, custody, destructive and release risks remain gated
success_criteria: success criteria must be explicit enough that later obvious questions become factory bugs
expected_deliverables: Product SOT, method route, architecture packet and execution readiness only after required gates pass

grouped_human_questions.question: Esse entendimento descreve o produto certo antes da fabrica continuar?
grouped_human_questions.why_it_matters: Evita que a fabrica transforme material inicial em escopo errado.

grouped_human_questions.question: Quais limites, nao-objetivos ou riscos nao podem entrar no primeiro ciclo?
grouped_human_questions.why_it_matters: Evita execucao material fora do limite autorizado.

handoff.next_safe_action: Ask the operator to confirm, correct or defer the Product Understanding Packet before material execution.
